name: kda_chain_verify_ring_n_verify_tokens5_n_heads12
description: Kimi-K3's KDA chain verify in ReplaySSM ring mode. Request r verifies tokens r * T to r * T + T - 1 (T = n_verify_tokens) from its distinct slot s = cache_indices[r]; a request whose slot is -1 is padding: it changes no slot or line, and its output is zero. A live request's convolution input is conv_state[s]'s three rows, oldest first, then its tokens: token t's channel c is SiLU of the exact sum of the four inputs ending at it times conv_weight[c], oldest first, rounded to BF16, and conv_window[window_indices[r], t] takes the last three inputs, oldest first. Head h takes the token's query, key and value channels: q is L2-normalized (epsilon 1e-6 added to the sum of squares) and multiplied by scale, k is L2-normalized. The gate is g = lower_bound * sigmoid(exp(a_log[h]) * (a + dt_bias[h])), or without a lower bound -exp(a_log[h]) times softplus of a + dt_bias[h] at softplus_beta, linear where softplus_beta times its input exceeds softplus_threshold; beta = sigmoid(b). From S = ssm_state[s, h] ([value, key]), each token in turn: S = S * exp(g) along the key, S = S + ((v - S k) * beta) outer k, output = S q. Rows 0 to T - 1 of slot s's rings take each token's convolved value (ring_v), convolved key before its normalization (ring_k), g (ring_g) and beta (ring_beta). ssm_state, conv_state, the other ring rows, unindexed slots and lines and all other inputs are preserved.

n_requests.description: Requests verified, sglang's graph padding requests included.

n_verify_tokens.description: Tokens a request verifies: its draft chain.

n_heads.description: KDA heads on this rank, query, key and value alike.

conv_dim.description: Convolution channels: every query head's, then every key head's, then every value head's.

ring_len.description: Rows of a slot's ring per head.

mixed_qkv.description: Each token's convolution input: every query head's channels, then every key head's, then every value head's; a request's tokens are consecutive rows, in chain order.

conv_weight.description: Each channel's four causal taps, the oldest input's first.

conv_state.description: Each slot's last three convolution inputs, oldest first.

cache_indices.description: Each request's distinct state slot, or -1 for a padding request.

conv_window.description: Convolution windows: a live request's line holds, after each of its tokens, the last three convolution inputs, oldest first.

a.description: The gate's input, one per key channel.

a_log.description: Log of each head's gate scale.

dt_bias.description: The gate's bias, one per key channel.

ssm_state.description: Each slot's recurrent state at its last committed token, value dimension first.

ring_v.description: Each slot's ReplaySSM ring of convolved values, a row per token: a live request's tokens write rows 0 on of its slot, the other rows stay.

ring_k.description: Each slot's ReplaySSM ring of convolved keys before their normalization, a row per token: a live request's tokens write rows 0 on of its slot, the other rows stay.

ring_g.description: Each slot's ReplaySSM ring of gates (log decays), a row per token: a live request's tokens write rows 0 on of its slot, the other rows stay.

ring_beta.description: Each slot's ReplaySSM ring of betas, a row per token: a live request's tokens write rows 0 on of its slot, the other rows stay.

lower_bound.description: The gate's lower bound (Kimi-K3's checkpoints: gate_lower_bound).

output.description: Each token's attention output, zero for a padding request's tokens.
